# T07 — AETHER Design Studio references
Research: TinyFish search then fetch, 2026-11-01.

## Studio shadows
- drei AccumulativeShadows: https://drei.docs.pmnd.rs/staging/accumulative-shadows. A planar Y-up shadow catcher paired with `RandomizedLight`; `temporal` + `frames` accumulates soft raycast-like contact shadows and costs nothing after the frames complete. Reset when the model changes.
- What I took: studio mode uses `AccumulativeShadows temporal frames={90}` with `RandomizedLight amount={8}` and a scale derived from the car length, not a single hard directional shadow.

## Reflective floor
- drei MeshReflectorMaterial: https://drei.docs.pmnd.rs/shaders/mesh-reflector-material. Blurred planar reflection controlled by `resolution`, `blur`, `mixStrength`, `mirror` and `depthScale`; low resolution is deliberate for a satin floor.
- What I took: a low-strength floor (`resolution={512}`, `mirror≈0.35`, `mixStrength≈6`) that catches the silhouette without turning the studio into a mirror.

## Showroom lighting
- drei Lightformer: https://drei.docs.pmnd.rs/staging/lightformer. Rect area lights build a dynamic environment map with no HDR download; intensity and scale control the highlight shape on clearcoat paint.
- R3F car showcase discussion: https://www.reddit.com/r/threejs/comments/wbtbbm/car_showcase_w_lights_reflections_full_code/. The recognisable showroom look comes from a large top softbox, two side strips and a rim, with a dark background.
- What I took: three softboxes (top key, left fill, rear rim) in an `Environment resolution={256}`, team-colour clearcoat paint, satin wings, rubber wheels and brushed cartridge metal.

## Visual references
- https://github.com/pmndrs/drei/raw/master/docs/assets/csb-thumbs/hxcc1x.webp: soft accumulated contact shadow under a product, no hard edge.
- https://codesandbox.io/api/v1/sandboxes/lx2h8/screenshot.png: blurred floor reflection that reads as a satin studio floor, not a mirror.
- https://codesandbox.io/api/v1/sandboxes/l900x/screenshot.png: rectangular softbox highlights stretched along glossy paint.

## Decisions
- Engineering mode keeps the neutral per-group palette and adds `Edges threshold={20}` plus the grid; studio mode removes edges and the grid.
- Dimensions and the two-point measure tool are labelled "approximate (display mesh)" because they use the tessellated GLB, not canonical CAD.
- Turntable is exactly 6°/s and stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
